description: Fork: two SchemaEpoch records claim epoch 1 with prev=null. The lower §4.5 order key wins (rA author aa < rB author bb), so rA (lww) is canonical and rB (gcounter) plus every op bound to it quarantine — application-visible, convergent, reversible if the M0d authority later ratifies rB. a2 is bound to the losing record and is excluded from materialized state; a1 (bound to the winner) materializes.
